description: List the collections (docs sites) in an organization, with each one's id, name, type and the caller's permission (1 read, 2 read-write). Each collection also has rootParentId: the parent pageId to use with create_page for a top-level page. Get orgId from list_organizations. Pass exclude=runCollection,environment to keep the response small. Ask the user which collection to work in.

exclude.description: Comma-separated list of collection columns to exclude from the response (e.g. large JSON fields). e.g. runCollection,environment

name: list_collections
